practical_conclusion: The dataset is large and magnifies preparation, host memory and transfer costs; it is not evidence that trees must be removed.
Current sampled limits are not explained by GPU capacity alone: AP occupies about53GiB yet averages25.3% utilization in the short sample; GST occupies about1.7GiB and waits for CPU windows.
More host RAM can satisfy explicit headroom/admission guards and retain banks, but does not by itself remove repeated preparation, allocator/syscall, transfer or recomputation work.

Evidence supports engineering profiling and a separately reviewed successor before considering a new scientific method. No accuracy/scientific necessity for data reduction or a new method has been established.
